titulo: Connecting it all: the weekly and monthly routine with an agent
lead: Five separate tools turn into forgotten work. One script runs each week's tools and each month's tools and saves the output with a date. An agent on your subscription (Claude Code or Codex) reads the report and proposes three actions, with the number that justifies each. You decide, and you are the one who changes the site: that is the human gate.
objetivo: set up the weekly and monthly routine for the 5 tools, with an agent that only reads and proposes and a human gate before the site changes.

aprende.t: What runs every week and what runs every month
A rotina.sh that saves everything with a date
The agent as observer: it only reads and proposes
The human gate and the decision record

hero_alt: A person reviews printed reports next to a laptop with a terminal, on a calm morning.

secoes.sub: The machine measures and proposes; a human decides. Tap each step.

nos.detalhe: After gsc_semanal.py: import and report. Non-branded queries, what went up and down, content backlog, and pages with no clicks.
auditor and agente-ready run on their own. bing-ia depends on you exporting the CSV from the dashboard (there is no API). botlog depends on you copying the log and filtering it.
Each run goes into a folder named with the date. The JSON reports stay there for the agent to read and for you to compare month to month.
Claude Code or Codex on your subscription, with no write tools. It reads the JSON and returns the number of the week, 3 proposals with the data that justifies them, and one question for the human.
You accept, postpone, or reject each proposal and note why. Only then does the change go to the site. It is the same gate as the "machine with agents" in the inemaSEO method.

secoes.volta: the decision goes back into next week's run
secoes.legenda: Nothing changes on the site without passing through the gate.

texto: Copy rotina.sh from the block below into a working folder and adjust the four variables: where inemaseo-sistemas lives, the Search Console property, the home page, and the folder with the CSVs.
Run bash rotina.sh semana and check the dated folder.

The weekly part can go in cron, right after gsc_semanal.py. The monthly one has two manual steps (the Bing export and copying the log): a calendar reminder works better than a cron job that fails silently.
Send the request and the relatorio.json to the agent, with no tools: it can't change anything.
The request tells it to use only the numbers in the report and reminds it that the content backlog is a heuristic.

exemplo.texto: claude -p and codex exec run through your subscription. Calling a model with an API key is a different thing, with per-use cost.

texto: For each proposal: accept, postpone or decline, with a one-line reason. The question "for the human to decide" is yours; the agent doesn't have the business context.
In the next rounds, add decisoes.md to the request (one more cat before the report) so the agent doesn't repeat what you declined.

secoes.titulo: The routine and the request to the agent
secoes.sub: Templates to copy. Every command inside them comes from the tools' READMEs.

blocos.conteudo:
#!/bin/bash
# rotina.sh — semana | mes. Runs the inemaseo-sistemas tools and saves the dated output.
set -e
SIS=~/inemaseo-sistemas/ferramentas   # where you cloned it
SITE=yoursite.com                       # Search Console property
URL=https://yoursite.com                # site home page
CSV=~/path/to/gsc-folder             # gsc_semanal.py folder
D=rotina/$(date +%F); mkdir -p $D dados

case "$1" in
  semana)
    python3 $SIS/gsc-historico/gsc_historico.py importar $CSV --db dados/gsc.sqlite
    python3 $SIS/gsc-historico/gsc_historico.py relatorio --db dados/gsc.sqlite --site $SITE --saida $D/gsc
    ;;
  mes)
    python3 $SIS/auditor/auditor.py $URL --max 50 -q --saida $D/auditor
    python3 $SIS/agente-ready/agente-ready.py $URL --saida $D/agente-ready
    # bing-ia: only after exporting the CSV from the Bing panel (there is no API)
    ls bing/*.csv >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 $SIS/bing-ia/bing_ia.py importar bing/*.csv --db dados/bing.sqlite \
      && python3 $SIS/bing-ia/bing_ia.py relatorio --db dados/bing.sqlite --gsc-db dados/gsc.sqlite --site $SITE --saida $D/bing-ia
    # botlog: only after copying the log (filter it before saving)
    ls logs/* >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 $SIS/botlog/botlog.py analisar logs/* --saida $D/botlog
    ;;
  *) echo "usage: bash rotina.sh semana|mes"; exit 1 ;;
esac
echo "output in $D"

blocos.rot: pedido-semana.md (template for the request to the agent)
blocos.conteudo:
You are the site's weekly SEO observer. Below is the relatorio.json from gsc-historico (this week's Search Console, non-branded queries only).

Rules:
- Read-only. Do not change any file, do not publish anything, do not run commands.
- Use only the numbers in the report; do not invent data.
- The "owner page" rule is a heuristic: check the column of the pages that appear today before proposing a new page.

Answer in English, in at most 12 lines:
1. One sentence with the week's number (non-branded clicks and impressions, compared with the previous week).
2. Exactly 3 proposals, each with: action (write new page / improve existing page / rewrite title), URL or query, and the number from the report that justifies it.
3. One line "For the human to decide:" with the question only the site owner can answer.

blocos.rot: Terminal · week + agent (Claude Code, no tools)
blocos.conteudo:
bash rotina.sh semana
(cat pedido-semana.md; echo; cat rotina/$(date +%F)/gsc/relatorio.json) | claude -p --tools "" > rotina/$(date +%F)/leitura-agente.md

# Decisions — week of <dd/mm/yyyy>
| agent proposal | decision | reason | who | when |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <improve /es/aprender-…/> | accept | <the page already shows up; strengthen the opening> | <name> | <dd/mm> |
| <rewrite title of /cursos/…> | postpone | <only 5 impressions; wait 2 more weeks> | <name> | <dd/mm> |
| <…> | decline | <…> | <name> | <dd/mm> |

abas.html:
bash rotina.sh semana with the sample CSVs from inema.club:

importado: 10 linha(s) de resumo, 244 linha(s) de consulta → dados/gsc.sqlite
inema.club semana 2026-10-11 (comparada com 2026-10-04): sem marca 0 cliques / 157 impr.; subiram 15, caíram 15, pauta 18, páginas sem clique 5 → rotina/2026-10-19/gsc/relatorio.html
output in rotina/2026-10-19

Real response from claude -p (Claude Code via subscription, no tools) to the request above, shortened:

1. Semana 05–11/10: 0 cliques e 157 impressões sem marca, contra 0 cliques
   e 47 impressões em 28/09–04/10.
2. Propostas (todas já têm página respondendo, então nenhuma página nova):
   - Melhorar /es/aprender-inteligencia-artificial/: 106 impressões,
     22 consultas, posição média 39,1 e 0 cliques. A pauta indicava página
     nova para algumas dessas consultas, mas é esta página que já aparece.
   - Reescrever o título de /cursos/278-laya-jev-decisoes-estruturadas-na-pratica/:
     posição média 7,4, 5 impressões e 0 cliques.
   - Melhorar /agentes-de-inteligencia-artificial/ para "curso de agentes
     de ia": 4 impressões, posição 34,8.
3. Para o humano decidir: vale investir no público em espanhol, que trouxe
   quase todo o crescimento da semana, ou o foco continua no português?

The agent also set aside, on its own, a query that looked like an internal test and did not use it. The decision about Spanish is up to the owner.

• Giving the observer write tools: it reads and proposes; whoever changes the site goes through the gate.
  • Asking "analyze the SEO": without rules (only the report's numbers, fixed format), the answer turns into generic opinion.
  • Cron on the Bing export: there is no API; that part is manual, with a reminder.
  • Forgetting decisoes.md: without it, the agent repeats every week what you already declined.

secoes.sub: Start with the weekly part; the monthly part comes in when the Bing export and the log are at hand.

exercicios.texto: Copy rotina.sh, adjust the four variables and run the weekly part (with your own CSVs or the sample ones).
exercicios.pronto: the rotina/ folder exists with today's date and, inside it, gsc/relatorio.json.

exercicios.texto: Send the request and the report to the agent with no tools and record your decision on each proposal.
exercicios.pronto: leitura-agente.md has 3 proposals with a number, and decisoes.md has one line per proposal with accept, postpone or decline and the reason.

secoes.sub: The explanation shows up after your answer.

perguntas.p: Why does the agent run with no tools (empty --tools)?
opcoes: To be an observer: it reads and proposes, with no way to change anything on the site.
perguntas.explica: The human gate only works if the agent can't act on its own. You are the one who applies the change, after you decide.

perguntas.p: Which part of the monthly routine can't be fully automated?
opcoes: The Bing AI Performance export, which has no API.
perguntas.explica: The CSV comes out of the dashboard. The botlog also depends on copying the log; that's why the monthly routine works better with a reminder than with cron.

perguntas.p: The content backlog called for a new page, and the agent proposed improving an existing page. Who was right?
opcoes: The agent, because the request said to check the pages that already show up; the content backlog is a heuristic.
perguntas.explica: The Spanish page was already showing up in queries. Creating another page for the same topic would split the signal. The final decision is still up to the human.

opcoes: To record accept, postpone, or decline with a reason, so the agent doesn't repeat what was declined.
perguntas.explica: It's the gate's memory. Month by month, it shows what was decided and why.

itens.texto: Week: gsc-historico. Month: auditor, agente-ready, bing-ia, and botlog.
Through the subscription, no tools: it reads the JSON and proposes 3 actions with numbers.
You decide and write it down; only then does the site change.
